cut: Doodle 5, VIRAL CUT v2 (23 Oct). Owner on v1: 'Police car is too big, ending too abruptly', 'the visual seems small for 130ha', '330 ha is huge'. Hook first; one pitch, then ~460 of them; before the assessment → a police inquiry → headlines in six languages; punch on 130 ha (≈ 180 pitches), hold, ease back, loop. The v1 draft (papercut/count-the-trees) is unchanged. v3 (24 Oct): owner asked if this was the Hamina case and wanted where and when: the hook names Muhos, Finland, 2026; a tag NEW Doodle DATA CENTRE · MUHOS, FINLAND sits above the clipping on frame 0 and on the last frame; the post says it is a different site from Hamina. v4 (24 Oct): owner 'Trees end is too fast and needs clarity. What's the end learning?' The punchline says it: 130 ha planned of ~330 ha felled, under half; the label pops on 'half', a ≥3.5 s hold, then a slower ease back.
argument: About 250,000 trees (by the Guardian's estimate), some 330 hectares or 460 football pitches, were cleared for Doodle's Muhos data centre before the required assessment. Police opened a preliminary inquiry. Planting planned: 130 hectares.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.ja: 2026年 フィンランド・ムホス： / 約25万本の 木が / [消えた]。

captions.source: The Guardian's investigation, 22 Oct 2026: an estimated 250,000 trees felled at Muhos (about 330 ha), as reported by follow-ups (Tom's Guide; Yahoo News; Timberbiz; Common Dreams headline). The original cannot be opened from this session; the clipping on screen credits it as the Guardian's estimate. Re-checked 23 Oct (plan/films/25b-count-the-trees-viral.md). v3 (24 Oct): place and year added to the hook (owner: 'where and when ... more clarity'). Muhos is a planned new Doodle data-centre site near Oulu, northern Finland; the felling was done in 2026 before the environmental impact assessment, and LVV ordered the preparatory work stopped on 6 Oct 2026 (AFP; Al Jazeera 7 Oct; DCD). It is a different site from Hamina (Doodle 6).

text.ja: 330ヘクタール＝ / サッカー場 / 約[460]面分。

captions.source: Arithmetic, not a report: a football pitch of 105 × 68 m is 7,140 m² = 0.714 ha; ~330 ha / 0.714 ha = 462 ('about 460'). The ~330 ha is the figure reported as Tuike Finland's own (the regulator says over 300; AFP, DCD, TechSpot). On screen the pitch is drawn to the clearing's own scale (0.409 px/m: 43.0 × 27.8 px) and 463 grid cells have their centre inside the red line.

text.ja: 義務づけられた / [環境影響評価] の / 前に 伐採。

captions.source: LVV (Finland's licensing and supervisory agency), 6 Oct 2026: preparatory work at Muhos and Kajaani to stop until the environmental impact assessments are done, by 23 Oct at the latest (AFP; Al Jazeera 7 Oct; ORF; Euronews). Doodle says it stopped on receiving the letters on 6 Oct.

text.ja: 警察が / [予備調査] を 開始。

captions.source: Oulu police have opened a preliminary inquiry (esiselvitys) into the preparatory work at Muhos, to establish whether there is reason to suspect a crime such as environmental damage; it followed a request filed by a private person on 2 Oct, and two requests in all. Iltalehti, as carried by Kaleva ('IL: Poliisi on aloittanut esiselvityksen Googlen Muhoksen datakeskuksen valmistelutöistä') and MTV Uutiset; Yle; Kaleva ('Oulun poliisille on tehty kaksi tutkintapyyntöä'). An esiselvitys is not a criminal investigation, and the film does not call it one.

text.en: Felled: ~330 ha. / Planting planned: / 130 ha. Under [half].
text.fi: Hakattu: ~330 ha. / Istutus suunnitteilla: / 130 ha. Alle [puolet].
text.ja: 伐採： 約330ha。 / 植樹の 計画： 130ha。 / [半分以下]。

captions.source: About 330 ha cleared at Muhos (the figure reported as Tuike Finland's own; the regulator says over 300). 130 ha: Doodle's own statement (AFP, about 7 Oct): its landscaping and biodiversity plans include tree planting across 130 hectares at Muhos. The sapling patch is drawn at 40 % of the clearing. v4 (owner, 24 Oct: 'What's the end learning?'): 130 of ~330 is 39 %, so 'under half' is arithmetic on the two sourced figures: 130 ha is Doodle's own planned planting at Muhos (AFP, ~7 Oct: tree planting across 130 hectares at Muhos); ~330 ha is the figure reported as Tuike's own felled area.

post.en: Muhos, northern Finland: about 250,000 trees (the Guardian's estimate), ~330 ha, cleared in 2026 for a planned new Doodle data centre, before the required environmental assessment. Police opened a preliminary inquiry. A different site from Hamina. Who counts the trees?
post.fi: Muhos, Pohjois-Suomi: noin 250 000 puuta (The Guardianin arvio), noin 330 hehtaaria, hakattiin 2026 Doodlen suunnitellulle uudelle datakeskukselle ennen lain vaatimaa ympäristöarviointia. Poliisi aloitti esiselvityksen. Eri paikka kuin Hamina. Kuka laskee puut?
post.ja: ガーディアン紙の推定で約25万本。約330ヘクタール、サッカー場約460面分の森が、フィンランド・ムホスでDoodleのデータセンターのため、義務づけられた環境影響評価の前に伐採された。警察が予備調査を開始。植樹の計画は130ヘクタール。木は誰が数える？
